analysis.headline: Sells & Shares Your Data
analysis.quote: We may share the types and categories of personal information collected with the categories of third parties below.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Sensitive Data
analysis.quote: Depending on applicable laws, some information within the categories above may be considered sensitive personal information, including government identifiers, payment information, race, precise geolocation data, and health data.

analysis.headline: Surveys You With Cameras
analysis.quote: We use cameras in and around our stores for operational purposes such as measuring traffic patterns and tracking in-stock levels.

analysis.headline: Tracks Your Car Plates
analysis.quote: We may use Automated License Plate Recognition (ALPR) technology where not prohibited by law to collect information relating to vehicles present at or near Target stores.

analysis.headline: Tracks Your Precise Location
analysis.quote: Geolocation data (e.g., latitude or longitude, in-store location)

analysis.headline: Third Parties Track You
analysis.quote: We also allow third-party companies (e.g., Google and Meta) to place tags or similar technologies on our digital properties.

analysis.headline: Monitors Your Chat Typing
analysis.quote: Chat functionality allows our Guest Relations specialists to see what a Guest is typing before hitting the send button.

analysis.headline: Retains Your Data Long-Term
analysis.quote: We retain your personal information for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Privacy Policy or for the period legally permitted or required.
